s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic facial swelling and skin lesions with a history of malignancy
salient_findings: Violaceous swelling with telangiectasia and necrosis on the face
Pain on palpation without fever or chills
Histopathological findings of atypical cells in dilated vessels
key_facts: 3-month history of pain, swelling, and erythema on the face
History of left breast carcinoma diagnosed eleven years earlier
Treated with mastectomy, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy
Left supraclavicular lymph nodes metastasis treated with surgical excision seven years after initial diagnosis
No fever or chills
Pain on palpation
Violaceous swelling with telangiectasia and necrosis on the forehead, eyelids, nose, and cheek
Predominantly involving the left side of the face
Histopathological examination showed hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and dilated vessels in the dermis
Immunohistochemical examination showed epithelial cells in dilated vessels positive for CD31 and atypical cells positive for GATA3

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic facial swelling and skin lesions with a history of malignancy
salient_findings: Violaceous swelling with telangiectasia and necrosis on the face
Pain on palpation without fever or chills
Histopathological findings of atypical cells in dilated vessels
key_facts: 3-month history of pain, swelling, and erythema on the face
History of left breast carcinoma diagnosed eleven years earlier
Treated with mastectomy, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy
Left supraclavicular lymph nodes metastasis treated with surgical excision seven years after initial diagnosis
No fever or chills
Pain on palpation
Violaceous swelling with telangiectasia and necrosis on the forehead, eyelids, nose, and cheek
Predominantly involving the left side of the face
Histopathological examination showed hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and dilated vessels in the dermis
Immunohistochemical examination showed epithelial cells in dilated vessels positive for CD31 and atypical cells positive for GATA3

differentials: metaplastic breast carcinoma with squamous differentiation

raw.rationale: The patient's history of left breast carcinoma and subsequent metastasis to the left supraclavicular lymph nodes, combined with the current symptoms and histopathological findings of atypical cells in dilated vessels, suggests that the facial lesions are metastatic in nature.

rejected.label: breast cancer
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of breast cancer, the current diagnosis is more likely a metastasis rather than a new primary breast cancer.

rejected.label: sarcoidosis
rejected.why: The presence of atypical cells and the patient's history of cancer make sarcoidosis less likely.

rejected.label: lymphoma
rejected.why: The histopathological and immunohistochemical findings do not support a diagnosis of lymphoma.

rejected.label: neoplasia
rejected.why: Neoplasia is a broad term that encompasses many types of tumors, but the specific findings in this case point more specifically to metastases.
